facts.fact: The op-ed states the Nigeria Computer Emergency Response Team (ngCERT) provides a national incident-response function and publishes security advisories; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The op-ed states the 2024 Designation and Protection of Critical National Information Infrastructure Order provides a policy foundation for critical information infrastructure.
